security-review.description: Parallel security review of code changes

agents.name: dependency-audit
agents.prompt: Audit all dependencies in pyproject.toml and uv.lock for known vulnerabilities. Check for outdated packages, insecure versions, and supply chain risks. Report findings with severity levels.

agents.name: code-security
agents.prompt: Review src/ for security issues: insecure defaults, weak crypto usage, improper key handling, injection vulnerabilities, and missing input validation. Cross-reference with docs/threat_model.md and skills/security_audit.md.

agents.name: test-coverage
agents.prompt: Review tests/ for coverage gaps. Identify untested code paths, missing edge cases, and areas where property-based testing (hypothesis) could strengthen the suite. Cross-reference with skills/property_based_testing.md.

code-quality.description: Parallel code quality and consistency checks

agents.name: lint-check
agents.prompt: Run ruff check on src/ and tests/. Fix any issues found and report what was fixed.

agents.name: type-check
agents.prompt: Run ty check on src/. Fix any type errors found and report what was fixed.

agents.name: modern-python
agents.prompt: Review src/ for modern Python best practices per skills/modern_python.md. Check for type hints, dataclasses, pathlib usage, and other modern idioms.

agents.name: docs-review
agents.prompt: Review docs/ for consistency with the current codebase. Flag any outdated specifications or missing documentation.

agents.name: skill-alignment
agents.prompt: Review skills/ to ensure they align with the project's coding principles and current practices. Flag any outdated guidance.
